s.en: show / manipulate PFC (Priority-based Flow Control) settings of the DCB (Data Center Bridging) subsystem

syn: dcb [ OPTIONS ] pfc { COMMAND | help } ⏎ dcb pfc show dev DEV [ pfc-cap ] [ prio-pfc ] [ macsec-bypass ] [ delay ] [ requests ] [ indications ] ⏎ dcb pfc set dev DEV [ prio-pfc PFC-MAP ] [ macsec-bypass { on | off } ] [ delay INTEGER ] ⏎ PFC-MAP := [ PFC-MAP ] PFC-MAPPING ⏎ PFC-MAPPING := { PRIO | all }:{ on | off } ⏎ PRIO := { 0 .. 7 }
